<script>
// ---------- Print preparation hooks ----------------------------------------
// Browsers do not honour `display: block` for collapsed <details>: pure CSS
// cannot force them open. We hook beforeprint/afterprint to:
//   1) open every <details> so all code-fold blocks print expanded
//   2) reveal every panel-tabset tab pane so all Appendix 2 robustness checks
//      print (the inactive tabs are display:none until clicked)
//   3) snap count-up <span> elements to their data-target final value
//      (in case the user prints before the IntersectionObserver fires)
// State is restored on afterprint so the on-screen experience is unchanged.
(() => {
  let detailsState = [];
  let panelState = [];
  let countUpState = [];

  const prepareForPrint = () => {
    detailsState = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("details")).map((d) => {
      const wasOpen = d.open;
      d.open = true;
      return { node: d, wasOpen };
    });

    panelState = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(".panel-tabset .tab-pane, .tab-content > .tab-pane")
    ).map((pane) => {
      const wasActive = pane.classList.contains("active");
      const wasShow   = pane.classList.contains("show");
      pane.classList.add("active", "show");
      pane.style.display = "block";
      return { node: pane, wasActive, wasShow };
    });

    // Force every interactive-figure into its animated state so SVG marks
    // (points, labels, connectors) become visible — they default to opacity:0
    // and rely on IntersectionObserver to add the .is-animated class, which
    // does not fire on print.
    document.querySelectorAll(".interactive-figure").forEach((fig) => {
      fig.classList.add("is-animated");
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".fade-section").forEach((sec) => {
      sec.classList.add("is-visible");
    });

    countUpState = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".count-up")).map((el) => {
      const original = el.textContent;
      const target   = el.dataset.target ?? "";
      const prefix   = el.dataset.prefix ?? "";
      const suffix   = el.dataset.suffix ?? "";
      const decimals = parseInt(el.dataset.decimals ?? "0", 10);
      const num      = Number(target);
      const text = (Number.isFinite(num)
        ? num.toFixed(decimals)
        : String(target));
      el.textContent = prefix + text + suffix;
      return { node: el, original };
    });
  };

  const restoreFromPrint = () => {
    detailsState.forEach(({ node, wasOpen }) => { node.open = wasOpen; });
    panelState.forEach(({ node, wasActive, wasShow }) => {
      if (!wasActive) node.classList.remove("active");
      if (!wasShow)   node.classList.remove("show");
      node.style.display = "";
    });
    countUpState.forEach(({ node, original }) => { node.textContent = original; });
    detailsState = []; panelState = []; countUpState = [];
  };

  window.addEventListener("beforeprint", prepareForPrint);
  window.addEventListener("afterprint", restoreFromPrint);

  // Some browsers (Chrome/Safari) fire matchMedia print events instead
  const mql = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia("print") : null;
  if (mql && typeof mql.addEventListener === "function") {
    mql.addEventListener("change", (e) => {
      if (e.matches) prepareForPrint(); else restoreFromPrint();
    });
  }
})();

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  document.documentElement.classList.add("reveal-enabled");
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  const svgNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  const parseData = (id) => {
    const element = document.getElementById(id);
    return element ? JSON.parse(element.textContent) : null;
  };

  const makeSvg = (tag, attrs = {}) => {
    const node = document.createElementNS(svgNS, tag);
    Object.entries(attrs).forEach(([key, value]) => {
      node.setAttribute(key, value);
    });
    return node;
  };

  const scaleLinear = (domain, range) => {
    const [d0, d1] = domain;
    const [r0, r1] = range;
    return (value) => r0 + ((value - d0) / (d1 - d0)) * (r1 - r0);
  };

  const clamp = (value, min, max) => Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));

  const coalColor = (share) => {
    const stops = [
      [35, [243, 226, 203]],
      [50, [227, 169, 102]],
      [65, [187, 96, 43]],
      [75, [118, 45, 23]]
    ];

    if (share <= stops[0][0]) {
      return `rgb(${stops[0][1].join(",")})`;
    }
    if (share >= stops[stops.length - 1][0]) {
      return `rgb(${stops[stops.length - 1][1].join(",")})`;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < stops.length - 1; i += 1) {
      const [startValue, startColor] = stops[i];
      const [endValue, endColor] = stops[i + 1];
      if (share >= startValue && share <= endValue) {
        const t = (share - startValue) / (endValue - startValue);
        const color = startColor.map((channel, index) =>
          Math.round(channel + (endColor[index] - channel) * t)
        );
        return `rgb(${color.join(",")})`;
      }
    }

    return "rgb(187,96,43)";
  };

  const countryColors = {
    Indonesia: "#945638",
    Vietnam: "#c87638",
    India: "#8f5c2c",
    Australia: "#7b8d9f",
    Japan: "#5f7488",
    "South Korea": "#667ca0"
  };

  const sourceColors = {
    Coal: "#1f3340",
    Oil: "#b46b34",
    Gas: "#4f7fa2",
    Cement: "#9ba3a8"
  };

  const createTooltip = (stage) => {
    const tooltip = document.createElement("div");
    tooltip.className = "chart-tooltip";
    stage.appendChild(tooltip);

    const move = (event) => {
      const rect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
      const left = clamp(
        event.clientX - rect.left + 16,
        10,
        rect.width - tooltip.offsetWidth - 10
      );
      const top = clamp(
        event.clientY - rect.top + 16,
        10,
        rect.height - tooltip.offsetHeight - 10
      );
      tooltip.style.left = `${left}px`;
      tooltip.style.top = `${top}px`;
    };

    return {
      show(event, html) {
        tooltip.innerHTML = html;
        tooltip.classList.add("is-visible");
        move(event);
      },
      move,
      hide() {
        tooltip.classList.remove("is-visible");
      }
    };
  };

  const bindButtonGroup = (container, attribute, callback) => {
    if (!container) return;
    const buttons = [...container.querySelectorAll("button")];
    buttons.forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        buttons.forEach((candidate) => {
          candidate.classList.toggle("is-active", candidate === button);
        });
        callback(button.getAttribute(attribute));
      });
    });
  };

  const setMuted = (nodes, muted) => {
    nodes.forEach((node) => {
      node.classList.toggle("is-muted", muted);
    });
  };

  const renderPriority = () => {
    const bundle = parseData("priority-data");
    const figure = document.querySelector('[data-chart="priority"]');
    if (!bundle || !figure) return;

    const stage = figure.querySelector('[data-chart-stage="priority"]');
    stage.innerHTML = "";
    const tooltip = createTooltip(stage);

    const width = 720;
    const height = 480;
    const margin = { top: 22, right: 124, bottom: 82, left: 70 };
    const plot = {
      left: margin.left,
      right: width - margin.right,
      top: margin.top,
      bottom: height - margin.bottom
    };

    const x = scaleLinear([150, 390], [plot.left, plot.right]);
    const y = scaleLinear([-40, 125], [plot.bottom, plot.top]);
    const radiusMax = Math.max(...bundle.points.map((point) => point.total_co2));
    const radius = (value) => 6 + Math.sqrt(value / radiusMax) * 16;

    const svg = makeSvg("svg", {
      viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
      role: "img",
      "aria-label":
        "Animated priority map comparing carbon intensity, emissions growth and coal share across six Indo-Pacific economies."
    });
    stage.appendChild(svg);

    svg.appendChild(
      makeSvg("rect", {
        x: x(bundle.zone.xmin),
        y: y(bundle.zone.ymax),
        width: x(bundle.zone.xmax) - x(bundle.zone.xmin),
        height: y(bundle.zone.ymin) - y(bundle.zone.ymax),
        class: "zone-fill"
      })
    );

    const xTicks = [160, 200, 240, 280, 320, 360];
    const yTicks = [-25, 0, 25, 50, 75, 100, 125];

    xTicks.forEach((tick) => {
      svg.appendChild(
        makeSvg("line", {
          x1: x(tick),
          y1: plot.top,
          x2: x(tick),
          y2: plot.bottom,
          class: "grid-line"
        })
      );
      const label = makeSvg("text", {
        x: x(tick),
        y: plot.bottom + 22,
        class: "tick-label",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
      label.textContent = tick;
      svg.appendChild(label);
    });

    yTicks.forEach((tick) => {
      svg.appendChild(
        makeSvg("line", {
          x1: plot.left,
          y1: y(tick),
          x2: plot.right,
          y2: y(tick),
          class: tick === 0 ? "axis-line axis-line--emphasis" : "grid-line"
        })
      );
      const label = makeSvg("text", {
        x: plot.left - 12,
        y: y(tick) + 4,
        class: "tick-label",
        "text-anchor": "end"
      });
      label.textContent = `${tick}%`;
      svg.appendChild(label);
    });

    svg.appendChild(
      makeSvg("line", {
        x1: plot.left,
        y1: plot.bottom,
        x2: plot.right,
        y2: plot.bottom,
        class: "axis-line"
      })
    );
    svg.appendChild(
      makeSvg("line", {
        x1: plot.left,
        y1: plot.top,
        x2: plot.left,
        y2: plot.bottom,
        class: "axis-line"
      })
    );

    svg.appendChild(
      makeSvg("line", {
        x1: x(bundle.benchmark_mean),
        y1: plot.top,
        x2: x(bundle.benchmark_mean),
        y2: plot.bottom,
        class: "benchmark-line"
      })
    );

    const benchmarkLabel = makeSvg("text", {
      x: x(bundle.benchmark_mean) + 6,
      y: plot.top + 16,
      class: "annotation-label",
      "text-anchor": "start"
    });
    benchmarkLabel.textContent = "Benchmark mean";
    svg.appendChild(benchmarkLabel);

    const zoneLabel = makeSvg("text", {
      x: x(bundle.zone.xmin) + 20,
      y: y(bundle.zone.ymax) + 32,
      class: "zone-label",
      "text-anchor": "start"
    });
    zoneLabel.textContent = "Priority zone";
    svg.appendChild(zoneLabel);

    const xAxisLabel = makeSvg("text", {
      x: (plot.left + plot.right) / 2,
      y: plot.bottom + 46,
      class: "axis-label",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    xAxisLabel.textContent = "Carbon intensity (t CO2 per million 2011 PPP$)";
    svg.appendChild(xAxisLabel);

    const yAxisLabel = makeSvg("text", {
      x: 20,
      y: (plot.top + plot.bottom) / 2,
      class: "axis-label",
      transform: `rotate(-90 20 ${(plot.top + plot.bottom) / 2})`,
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    yAxisLabel.textContent = "CO2 growth, 2012-2022";
    svg.appendChild(yAxisLabel);

    const key = makeSvg("text", {
      x: plot.right,
      y: height - 10,
      class: "annotation-label",
      "text-anchor": "end"
    });
    key.textContent = "Fill = coal share   |   Size = total CO2";
    svg.appendChild(key);

    const pointBundles = [];
    let activeFilter = "all";
    let activeCountry = null;
    const priorityTooltips = new Map();

    const applyPriorityState = () => {
      pointBundles.forEach((bundleItem) => {
        const matchesFilter =
          activeFilter === "all" || bundleItem.group === activeFilter;
        const isFocused = activeCountry === bundleItem.country;
        const muted =
          !matchesFilter || (activeCountry !== null && !isFocused);

        setMuted(bundleItem.nodes, muted);
        bundleItem.nodes.forEach((node) => {
          node.classList.toggle("is-focus", matchesFilter && isFocused);
        });

        if (matchesFilter && isFocused) {
          bundleItem.drawOrder.forEach((node) => svg.appendChild(node));
        }
      });
    };

    const clearFocus = () => {
      activeCountry = null;
      applyPriorityState();
      tooltip.hide();
    };

    bundle.points.forEach((point, index) => {
      const anchor = point.label_x >= point.carbon_intensity ? "start" : "end";

      const halo = makeSvg("circle", {
        cx: x(point.carbon_intensity),
        cy: y(point.growth),
        r: radius(point.total_co2) + 6,
        class: `chart-halo group-${point.group}`
      });
      svg.appendChild(halo);

      const connector = makeSvg("line", {
        x1: x(point.carbon_intensity),
        y1: y(point.growth),
        x2: x(point.label_x),
        y2: y(point.label_y),
        class: `chart-connector group-${point.group}`
      });
      connector.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 70 + 40}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(connector);

      const label = makeSvg("text", {
        x: x(point.label_x),
        y: y(point.label_y) - 8,
        class: `chart-label group-${point.group}`,
        "text-anchor": anchor
      });
      label.textContent = point.country;
      label.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 70 + 60}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(label);

      const circle = makeSvg("circle", {
        cx: x(point.carbon_intensity),
        cy: y(point.growth),
        r: radius(point.total_co2),
        fill: coalColor(point.coal_share),
        class: `chart-point group-${point.group}`,
        stroke: point.group === "target" ? "#17313f" : "#5d7484",
        "stroke-width": point.group === "target" ? 1.6 : 1.1
      });
      circle.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 70}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(circle);

      const nodes = [circle, connector, label];
      const tooltipHtml = `
        <strong>${point.country}</strong><br>
        Carbon intensity: ${point.carbon_intensity.toFixed(1)}<br>
        CO2 growth: ${point.growth > 0 ? "+" : ""}${point.growth.toFixed(1)}%<br>
        Coal share: ${point.coal_share.toFixed(1)}%<br>
        Total CO2: ${point.total_co2.toFixed(0)} Mt
      `;
      priorityTooltips.set(point.country, tooltipHtml);

      [circle, connector, label].forEach((node) => {
        node.setAttribute("data-priority-country", point.country);
      });

      pointBundles.push({
        country: point.country,
        group: point.group,
        nodes: [halo, circle, connector, label],
        drawOrder: [halo, connector, label, circle]
      });
    });

    const controls = figure.querySelector('[data-chart-controls="priority"]');
    bindButtonGroup(controls, "data-filter", (filter) => {
      activeFilter = filter;
      activeCountry = null;
      applyPriorityState();
    });

    const getPriorityTarget = (target) =>
      target && target.closest
        ? target.closest("[data-priority-country]")
        : null;

    stage.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      const targetNode = getPriorityTarget(event.target);
      if (!targetNode) {
        if (activeCountry !== null) clearFocus();
        return;
      }

      const country = targetNode.getAttribute("data-priority-country");
      const tooltipHtml = priorityTooltips.get(country);
      if (!tooltipHtml) {
        clearFocus();
        return;
      }

      activeCountry = country;
      applyPriorityState();
      tooltip.show(event, tooltipHtml);
    });
    stage.addEventListener("pointerout", (event) => {
      if (!stage.contains(event.relatedTarget)) {
        clearFocus();
      }
    });
    stage.addEventListener("pointerleave", clearFocus);
    figure.addEventListener("mouseleave", clearFocus);
    document.addEventListener("pointermove", (event) => {
      if (activeCountry !== null && !figure.contains(event.target)) {
        clearFocus();
      }
    });
    window.addEventListener("scroll", clearFocus, { passive: true });

    figure.__animate = () => {
      figure.classList.add("is-animated");
    };
  };

  const renderTrend = () => {
    const bundle = parseData("trend-data");
    const figure = document.querySelector('[data-chart="trend"]');
    if (!bundle || !figure) return;

    const stage = figure.querySelector('[data-chart-stage="trend"]');
    stage.innerHTML = "";
    const tooltip = createTooltip(stage);

    const width = 720;
    const height = 440;
    const margin = { top: 22, right: 126, bottom: 54, left: 70 };
    const plot = {
      left: margin.left,
      right: width - margin.right,
      top: margin.top,
      bottom: height - margin.bottom
    };

    const x = scaleLinear([1990, 2022], [plot.left, plot.right]);
    const yValues = bundle.series.map((row) => row.carbon_intensity);
    const yMin = Math.max(150, Math.floor((Math.min(...yValues) - 20) / 25) * 25);
    const yMax = Math.ceil((Math.max(...yValues) + 20) / 25) * 25;
    const y = scaleLinear([yMin, yMax], [plot.bottom, plot.top]);

    const svg = makeSvg("svg", {
      viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
      role: "img",
      "aria-label":
        "Animated line chart showing carbon intensity trends from 1990 to 2022 for six Indo-Pacific economies."
    });
    stage.appendChild(svg);

    svg.appendChild(
      makeSvg("rect", {
        x: plot.left,
        y: plot.top,
        width: plot.right - plot.left,
        height: y(bundle.band.ymin) - plot.top,
        class: "band-fill"
      })
    );

    const bandLabel = makeSvg("text", {
      x: plot.left + 8,
      y: plot.top + 18,
      class: "annotation-label",
      "text-anchor": "start"
    });
    bandLabel.textContent = "Higher-intensity band";
    svg.appendChild(bandLabel);

    const xTicks = [1990, 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020];
    const yTicks = [];
    for (let tick = Math.ceil(yMin / 50) * 50; tick <= Math.floor(yMax / 50) * 50; tick += 50) {
      yTicks.push(tick);
    }

    xTicks.forEach((tick) => {
      svg.appendChild(
        makeSvg("line", {
          x1: x(tick),
          y1: plot.top,
          x2: x(tick),
          y2: plot.bottom,
          class: "grid-line"
        })
      );
      const label = makeSvg("text", {
        x: x(tick),
        y: plot.bottom + 22,
        class: "tick-label",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
      label.textContent = tick;
      svg.appendChild(label);
    });

    yTicks.forEach((tick) => {
      svg.appendChild(
        makeSvg("line", {
          x1: plot.left,
          y1: y(tick),
          x2: plot.right,
          y2: y(tick),
          class: "grid-line"
        })
      );
      const label = makeSvg("text", {
        x: plot.left - 12,
        y: y(tick) + 4,
        class: "tick-label",
        "text-anchor": "end"
      });
      label.textContent = tick;
      svg.appendChild(label);
    });

    svg.appendChild(
      makeSvg("line", {
        x1: plot.left,
        y1: plot.bottom,
        x2: plot.right,
        y2: plot.bottom,
        class: "axis-line"
      })
    );
    svg.appendChild(
      makeSvg("line", {
        x1: plot.left,
        y1: plot.top,
        x2: plot.left,
        y2: plot.bottom,
        class: "axis-line"
      })
    );

    svg.appendChild(
      makeSvg("line", {
        x1: x(2012),
        y1: plot.top,
        x2: x(2012),
        y2: plot.bottom,
        class: "focus-line"
      })
    );

    const focusLabel = makeSvg("text", {
      x: x(2012) + 6,
      y: plot.bottom - 8,
      class: "annotation-label",
      "text-anchor": "start"
    });
    focusLabel.textContent = "2012 baseline";
    svg.appendChild(focusLabel);

    const xAxisLabel = makeSvg("text", {
      x: (plot.left + plot.right) / 2,
      y: height - 10,
      class: "axis-label",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    xAxisLabel.textContent = "Year";
    svg.appendChild(xAxisLabel);

    const yAxisLabel = makeSvg("text", {
      x: 20,
      y: (plot.top + plot.bottom) / 2,
      class: "axis-label",
      transform: `rotate(-90 20 ${(plot.top + plot.bottom) / 2})`,
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    yAxisLabel.textContent = "Carbon intensity (t CO2 per million 2011 PPP$)";
    svg.appendChild(yAxisLabel);

    const seriesMap = new Map();
    bundle.series.forEach((row) => {
      if (!seriesMap.has(row.country)) {
        seriesMap.set(row.country, []);
      }
      seriesMap.get(row.country).push(row);
    });

    const endpointMap = new Map(
      bundle.endpoints.map((row) => [row.country, row])
    );

    const lineBundles = [];
    const animatedPaths = [];

    [...seriesMap.entries()].forEach(([country, rows], index) => {
      rows.sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
      const endpoint = endpointMap.get(country);
      const group = rows[0].group;
      const color = countryColors[country] || "#6b7280";

      const pathData = rows
        .map((row, rowIndex) => {
          const prefix = rowIndex === 0 ? "M" : "L";
          return `${prefix}${x(row.year).toFixed(2)},${y(row.carbon_intensity).toFixed(2)}`;
        })
        .join(" ");

      const path = makeSvg("path", {
        d: pathData,
        class: `chart-line group-${group}`,
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": group === "target" ? 3.2 : 2.4
      });
      svg.appendChild(path);
      animatedPaths.push(path);

      const endpointCircle = makeSvg("circle", {
        cx: x(endpoint.year),
        cy: y(endpoint.end_value),
        r: 4.2,
        fill: color,
        class: `chart-endpoint group-${group}`
      });
      endpointCircle.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 90 + 120}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(endpointCircle);

      const label = makeSvg("text", {
        x: plot.right + 10,
        y: y(endpoint.label_y),
        class: `chart-label group-${group}`,
        "text-anchor": "start",
        fill: color
      });
      label.textContent = country;
      label.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 90 + 140}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(label);

      const tooltipHtml = `
        <strong>${country}</strong><br>
        2022 intensity: ${endpoint.end_value.toFixed(1)}<br>
        Change since 2012: ${endpoint.change > 0 ? "+" : ""}${endpoint.change.toFixed(1)}%
      `;

      [path, endpointCircle, label].forEach((node) => {
        node.addEventListener("mouseenter", (event) => tooltip.show(event, tooltipHtml));
        node.addEventListener("mousemove", tooltip.move);
        node.addEventListener("mouseleave", tooltip.hide);
      });

      lineBundles.push({ group, nodes: [path, endpointCircle, label] });
    });

    const controls = figure.querySelector('[data-chart-controls="trend"]');
    bindButtonGroup(controls, "data-filter", (filter) => {
      lineBundles.forEach((bundleItem) => {
        const muted = filter !== "all" && bundleItem.group !== filter;
        setMuted(bundleItem.nodes, muted);
      });
    });

    figure.__animate = () => {
      figure.classList.add("is-animated");
      animatedPaths.forEach((path, index) => {
        if (reduceMotion) {
          path.style.strokeDasharray = "none";
          path.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
          return;
        }
        const length = path.getTotalLength();
        path.style.strokeDasharray = `${length}`;
        path.style.strokeDashoffset = `${length}`;
        path.getBoundingClientRect();
        path.style.transition =
          `stroke-dashoffset 1100ms ease ${index * 120}ms, opacity 180ms ease`;
        path.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
      });
    };
  };

  const renderFuel = () => {
    const bundle = parseData("fuel-data");
    const figure = document.querySelector('[data-chart="fuel"]');
    if (!bundle || !figure) return;

    const stage = figure.querySelector('[data-chart-stage="fuel"]');
    stage.innerHTML = "";
    const tooltip = createTooltip(stage);

    const width = 720;
    const height = 392;
    const margin = { top: 22, right: 90, bottom: 48, left: 118 };
    const plot = {
      left: margin.left,
      right: width - margin.right,
      top: margin.top,
      bottom: height - margin.bottom
    };

    const x = scaleLinear([0, 100], [plot.left, plot.right]);
    const countries = bundle.order;
    const rowGap = (plot.bottom - plot.top) / countries.length;
    const barHeight = Math.min(28, rowGap * 0.58);

    const svg = makeSvg("svg", {
      viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
      role: "img",
      "aria-label":
        "Animated stacked bar chart showing the composition of coal, oil, gas and cement emissions for six Indo-Pacific economies in 2022."
    });
    stage.appendChild(svg);

    const xTicks = [0, 25, 50, 75, 100];
    xTicks.forEach((tick) => {
      svg.appendChild(
        makeSvg("line", {
          x1: x(tick),
          y1: plot.top,
          x2: x(tick),
          y2: plot.bottom,
          class: "grid-line"
        })
      );
      const label = makeSvg("text", {
        x: x(tick),
        y: plot.bottom + 22,
        class: "tick-label",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
      label.textContent = `${tick}%`;
      svg.appendChild(label);
    });

    svg.appendChild(
      makeSvg("line", {
        x1: plot.left,
        y1: plot.bottom,
        x2: plot.right,
        y2: plot.bottom,
        class: "axis-line"
      })
    );

    const xAxisLabel = makeSvg("text", {
      x: (plot.left + plot.right) / 2,
      y: height - 8,
      class: "axis-label",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    xAxisLabel.textContent = "Share of fossil + cement CO2";
    svg.appendChild(xAxisLabel);

    const grouped = new Map();
    bundle.segments.forEach((segment) => {
      if (!grouped.has(segment.country)) {
        grouped.set(segment.country, []);
      }
      grouped.get(segment.country).push(segment);
    });

    const segmentBundles = [];

    countries.forEach((country, countryIndex) => {
      const row = grouped.get(country) || [];
      row.sort(
        (left, right) =>
          ["Coal", "Oil", "Gas", "Cement"].indexOf(left.source) -
          ["Coal", "Oil", "Gas", "Cement"].indexOf(right.source)
      );

      const yCenter = plot.top + rowGap * countryIndex + rowGap / 2;
      const label = makeSvg("text", {
        x: plot.left - 12,
        y: yCenter + 4,
        class: "bar-country-label",
        "text-anchor": "end"
      });
      label.textContent = country;
      label.style.transitionDelay = `${countryIndex * 70 + 40}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(label);

      let cumulative = 0;
      let coalShare = 0;

      row.forEach((segment, segmentIndex) => {
        const rect = makeSvg("rect", {
          x: x(cumulative),
          y: yCenter - barHeight / 2,
          width: x(cumulative + segment.share) - x(cumulative),
          height: barHeight,
          fill: sourceColors[segment.source],
          class: `chart-segment group-${segment.group} source-${segment.source}`
        });
        rect.style.transitionDelay = `${countryIndex * 70 + segmentIndex * 70}ms`;
        svg.appendChild(rect);

        const tooltipHtml = `
          <strong>${country}</strong><br>
          ${segment.source}: ${segment.share.toFixed(1)}%
        `;
        rect.addEventListener("mouseenter", (event) => tooltip.show(event, tooltipHtml));
        rect.addEventListener("mousemove", tooltip.move);
        rect.addEventListener("mouseleave", tooltip.hide);

        segmentBundles.push({
          source: segment.source,
          nodes: [rect]
        });

        if (segment.source === "Coal") {
          coalShare = segment.share;
        }
        cumulative += segment.share;
      });

      const coalNote = makeSvg("text", {
        x: plot.right + 10,
        y: yCenter + 4,
        class: "coal-note",
        "text-anchor": "start"
      });
      coalNote.textContent = `${coalShare.toFixed(1)}% coal`;
      coalNote.style.transitionDelay = `${countryIndex * 70 + 90}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(coalNote);
      segmentBundles.push({
        source: "CoalNote",
        nodes: [coalNote]
      });
    });

    const controls = figure.querySelector('[data-chart-controls="fuel"]');
    bindButtonGroup(controls, "data-mode", (mode) => {
      segmentBundles.forEach((bundleItem) => {
        const isCoalRelated =
          bundleItem.source === "Coal" || bundleItem.source === "CoalNote";
        const muted = mode === "coal" && !isCoalRelated;
        setMuted(bundleItem.nodes, muted);
      });
    });

    figure.__animate = () => {
      figure.classList.add("is-animated");
    };
  };

  const renderTransitionGap = () => {
    const bundle = parseData("transition-gap-data");
    const figure = document.querySelector('[data-chart="transition-gap"]');
    if (!bundle || !figure) return;

    const stage = figure.querySelector('[data-chart-stage="transition-gap"]');
    stage.innerHTML = "";
    const tooltip = createTooltip(stage);

    const rows = [...bundle.rows];
    const width = 720;
    const height = 408;
    const margin = { top: 30, right: 28, bottom: 64, left: 120 };
    const plot = {
      left: margin.left,
      right: width - margin.right,
      top: margin.top,
      bottom: height - margin.bottom
    };

    const values = rows.flatMap((row) => [row.pred_current, row.pred_bench]);
    const xMin = Math.floor((Math.min(...values) - 8) / 10) * 10;
    const xMax = Math.ceil((Math.max(...values) + 4) / 5) * 5;
    const x = scaleLinear([xMin, xMax], [plot.left, plot.right]);
    const rowGap = (plot.bottom - plot.top) / rows.length;
    const y = (index) => plot.top + rowGap * index + rowGap / 2;

    const svg = makeSvg("svg", {
      viewBox: `0 0 ${width} ${height}`,
      role: "img",
      "aria-label":
        "Animated transition-gap chart comparing current predicted carbon intensity with a benchmark coal-share counterfactual."
    });
    stage.appendChild(svg);

    const xTicks = [];
    for (
      let tick = Math.ceil(xMin / 20) * 20;
      tick <= Math.floor(xMax / 20) * 20;
      tick += 20
    ) {
      xTicks.push(tick);
    }

    xTicks.forEach((tick) => {
      svg.appendChild(
        makeSvg("line", {
          x1: x(tick),
          y1: plot.top,
          x2: x(tick),
          y2: plot.bottom,
          class: "grid-line"
        })
      );
      const tickLabel = makeSvg("text", {
        x: x(tick),
        y: plot.bottom + 24,
        class: "tick-label",
        "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
      tickLabel.textContent = tick;
      svg.appendChild(tickLabel);
    });

    rows.forEach((row, index) => {
      svg.appendChild(
        makeSvg("line", {
          x1: plot.left,
          y1: y(index),
          x2: plot.right,
          y2: y(index),
          class: "grid-line transition-row-guide"
        })
      );
    });

    svg.appendChild(
      makeSvg("line", {
        x1: plot.left,
        y1: plot.bottom,
        x2: plot.right,
        y2: plot.bottom,
        class: "axis-line"
      })
    );

    const xAxisLabel = makeSvg("text", {
      x: (plot.left + plot.right) / 2,
      y: height - 10,
      class: "axis-label",
      "text-anchor": "middle"
    });
    xAxisLabel.textContent =
      "Predicted carbon intensity (tonnes CO2 per million 2011 PPP$)";
    svg.appendChild(xAxisLabel);

    const rowBundles = [];
    const animatedLines = [];
    let activeCountry = null;

    const rowColor = (row) => {
      if (row.group === "benchmark") return "#7b8d9f";
      if (row.group === "support") return "#b08a3a";
      return countryColors[row.country] || "#c87638";
    };

    const applyTransitionFocus = () => {
      rowBundles.forEach((bundleItem) => {
        const isFocused = activeCountry === bundleItem.country;
        bundleItem.nodes.forEach((node) => {
          node.classList.toggle("is-focus", isFocused);
        });
      });
    };

    const clearTransitionFocus = () => {
      activeCountry = null;
      applyTransitionFocus();
      tooltip.hide();
    };

    rows.forEach((row, index) => {
      const yCenter = y(index);
      const currentX = x(row.pred_current);
      const benchX = x(row.pred_bench);
      const leftX = Math.min(currentX, benchX);
      const colour = rowColor(row);

      const countryLabel = makeSvg("text", {
        x: plot.left - 10,
        y: yCenter + 4,
        class: "transition-country-label",
        "text-anchor": "end"
      });
      countryLabel.textContent = row.country;
      countryLabel.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 34 + 25}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(countryLabel);

      const gapLabel = makeSvg("text", {
        x: Math.max(plot.left + 18, leftX - 16),
        y: yCenter + 4,
        class: "transition-gap-label",
        "text-anchor": "end"
      });
      gapLabel.textContent = row.label;
      gapLabel.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 34 + 75}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(gapLabel);

      const gapLine = makeSvg("line", {
        x1: currentX,
        y1: yCenter,
        x2: benchX,
        y2: yCenter,
        class: `transition-gap-line group-${row.group}`,
        stroke: colour
      });
      svg.appendChild(gapLine);
      animatedLines.push(gapLine);

      const benchPoint = makeSvg("circle", {
        cx: benchX,
        cy: yCenter,
        r: 6.2,
        class: "transition-point transition-point--bench"
      });
      benchPoint.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 34 + 90}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(benchPoint);

      const currentPoint = makeSvg("circle", {
        cx: currentX,
        cy: yCenter,
        r: 6.4,
        fill: colour,
        class: `transition-point transition-point--current group-${row.group}`
      });
      currentPoint.style.transitionDelay = `${index * 34 + 110}ms`;
      svg.appendChild(currentPoint);

      const tooltipHtml = `
        <strong>${row.country}</strong><br>
        Current prediction: ${row.pred_current.toFixed(1)}<br>
        Benchmark-share prediction: ${row.pred_bench.toFixed(1)}<br>
        Modelled gap: ${row.label}<br>
        2022 coal share: ${row.coal_share.toFixed(1)}%
      `;
      const nodes = [countryLabel, gapLabel, gapLine, benchPoint, currentPoint];
      nodes.forEach((node) => {
        node.setAttribute("data-transition-country", row.country);
        node.addEventListener("mouseenter", (event) => {
          activeCountry = row.country;
          applyTransitionFocus();
          tooltip.show(event, tooltipHtml);
        });
        node.addEventListener("mousemove", tooltip.move);
      });

      rowBundles.push({
        country: row.country,
        nodes
      });
    });

    stage.addEventListener("pointerleave", clearTransitionFocus);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", clearTransitionFocus, { passive: true });

    figure.__animate = () => {
      if (figure.__transitionAnimated) return;
      figure.__transitionAnimated = true;

      animatedLines.forEach((line, index) => {
        if (reduceMotion) {
          line.style.strokeDasharray = "none";
          line.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
          return;
        }
        const length = line.getTotalLength();
        line.style.strokeDasharray = `${length}`;
        line.style.strokeDashoffset = `${length}`;
        line.style.transition =
          `stroke-dashoffset 620ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) ${index * 42 + 45}ms, opacity 180ms ease`;
      });

      figure.classList.add("is-animated");

      if (!reduceMotion) {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          animatedLines.forEach((line) => {
            line.style.strokeDashoffset = "0";
          });
        });
      }
    };
  };

  const revealTargets = document.querySelectorAll(".fade-section");

  const revealNode = (target) => {
    target.classList.add("is-visible");
    if (typeof target.__animate === "function" && !target.__animated) {
      target.__animate();
      target.__animated = true;
    }
  };

  const revealAllSections = () => {
    revealTargets.forEach(revealNode);
  };

  const safeRender = (name, renderFn) => {
    try {
      renderFn();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(`Unable to render ${name}; revealing report content instead.`, error);
      revealAllSections();
    }
  };

  safeRender("Figure 1 priority map", renderPriority);
  safeRender("Figure 2 intensity trends", renderTrend);
  safeRender("Figure 3 fuel mix", renderFuel);
  safeRender("Transition gap chart", renderTransitionGap);

  const isInViewport = (target) => {
    const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    const height = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
    return rect.top < height * 0.94 && rect.bottom > height * 0.06;
  };

  const revealVisibleSections = () => {
    revealTargets.forEach((target) => {
      if (!target.classList.contains("is-visible") && isInViewport(target)) {
        revealNode(target);
      }
    });
  };

  if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          revealNode(entry.target);
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, {
      threshold: reduceMotion ? 0.01 : 0.18,
      rootMargin: "0px 0px -40px 0px"
    });

    revealTargets.forEach((target) => {
      observer.observe(target);
    });
    requestAnimationFrame(revealVisibleSections);
    window.addEventListener("load", revealVisibleSections, { once: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", revealVisibleSections, { passive: true });
  } else {
    revealAllSections();
  }

  // ---- Interactive citation popover ----
  // The popover is a real DOM node (not a CSS pseudo) so users can move
  // into it, select text, and click embedded links. It pulls its HTML from
  // the References list so there is a single source of truth for references.
  const refMap = new Map();
  document.querySelectorAll('.reference-list > p[id^="ref-"]').forEach((p) => {
    refMap.set(p.id, p.innerHTML);
  });

  const citeLinks = [...document.querySelectorAll("a.cite-link")];
  if (citeLinks.length && refMap.size) {
    const popover = document.createElement("div");
    popover.className = "cite-popover";
    popover.setAttribute("role", "tooltip");
    popover.innerHTML =
      '<span class="cite-popover__eyebrow">Reference</span>' +
      '<div class="cite-popover__body"></div>';
    document.body.appendChild(popover);
    const popoverBody = popover.querySelector(".cite-popover__body");

    let hideTimer = null;
    let currentLink = null;

    const positionPopover = (link) => {
      // Show off-screen first so measurement is accurate
      popover.style.visibility = "hidden";
      popover.classList.add("is-visible");

      const linkRect = link.getBoundingClientRect();
      const popRect = popover.getBoundingClientRect();
      const viewportWidth = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
      const scrollY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
      const scrollX = window.scrollX || window.pageXOffset;

      const margin = 12;
      let left = linkRect.left + scrollX;
      const maxLeft =
        scrollX + viewportWidth - popRect.width - margin;
      const minLeft = scrollX + margin;
      if (left > maxLeft) left = maxLeft;
      if (left < minLeft) left = minLeft;

      const linkCentre = linkRect.left + linkRect.width / 2 + scrollX;
      const arrowX = clamp(linkCentre - left - 5, 14, popRect.width - 24);

      popover.style.top = `${linkRect.bottom + scrollY + 10}px`;
      popover.style.left = `${left}px`;
      popover.style.setProperty("--arrow-x", `${arrowX}px`);
      popover.style.visibility = "";
    };

    const showCite = (link) => {
      clearTimeout(hideTimer);
      const href = link.getAttribute("href") || "";
      const id = href.replace(/^#/, "");
      const html = refMap.get(id);
      if (!html) return;
      currentLink = link;
      popoverBody.innerHTML = html;
      positionPopover(link);
    };

    const scheduleHide = () => {
      clearTimeout(hideTimer);
      hideTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        popover.classList.remove("is-visible");
        currentLink = null;
      }, 260);
    };

    const cancelHide = () => {
      clearTimeout(hideTimer);
    };

    citeLinks.forEach((link) => {
      link.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => showCite(link));
      link.addEventListener("focus", () => showCite(link));
      link.addEventListener("mouseleave", scheduleHide);
      link.addEventListener("blur", scheduleHide);
    });

    popover.addEventListener("mouseenter", cancelHide);
    popover.addEventListener("mouseleave", scheduleHide);

    window.addEventListener(
      "scroll",
      () => {
        if (currentLink && popover.classList.contains("is-visible")) {
          positionPopover(currentLink);
        }
      },
      { passive: true }
    );

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      if (currentLink && popover.classList.contains("is-visible")) {
        positionPopover(currentLink);
      }
    });
  }

  // ---- Count-up animation for Key Insights cards ----
  const countUpNodes = [...document.querySelectorAll(".count-up")];
  const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

  const runCountUp = (node) => {
    if (node.dataset.counted === "true") return;
    node.dataset.counted = "true";

    const target = parseFloat(node.dataset.target);
    if (!Number.isFinite(target)) {
      node.textContent = node.dataset.target || "";
      return;
    }

    const decimals = parseInt(node.dataset.decimals || "0", 10);
    const prefix = node.dataset.prefix || "";
    const suffix = node.dataset.suffix || "";
    const duration = reduceMotion ? 0 : 1400;

    if (duration === 0) {
      node.textContent = `${prefix}${target.toFixed(decimals)}${suffix}`;
      return;
    }

    const start = performance.now();
    const step = (now) => {
      const elapsed = now - start;
      const t = Math.min(1, elapsed / duration);
      const value = target * easeOutCubic(t);
      const signedPrefix =
        prefix === "+" && target < 0 ? "-" : prefix;
      const shown =
        prefix === "+" ? Math.abs(value).toFixed(decimals) : value.toFixed(decimals);
      node.textContent = `${signedPrefix}${shown}${suffix}`;
      if (t < 1) {
        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      } else {
        const finalSigned =
          prefix === "+" && target < 0 ? "-" : prefix;
        const finalShown =
          prefix === "+" ? Math.abs(target).toFixed(decimals) : target.toFixed(decimals);
        node.textContent = `${finalSigned}${finalShown}${suffix}`;
      }
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };

  if (countUpNodes.length) {
    const countObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          runCountUp(entry.target);
          countObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.35 });

    countUpNodes.forEach((node) => countObserver.observe(node));
  }
});
</script>
